title: member_suspended
description: A member's account was suspended by an administrator. Not yet dispatched by Pro's Outgoing_Webhooks (no member_suspended entry in get_event_source_map()) - this describes the flat payload the declared Payload::user() builder (wb_listora_automation_payload_user()) would produce, flattened at the top level with no nested envelope, plus reason and suspended_by.

reason.description: Reason given for the suspension, if any.

suspended_by.description: User ID of the administrator who applied the suspension.
